notes: Primary source: Hypixel SkyBlock Wiki Mutations page table plus each mutation page (raw wikitext). Georik Greenhouse tab used for Copper/cost cross-check. Local video notes used as fallback; where videos disagree with the wiki the wiki wins.

copper.analyzeRepeat = Copper granted per analysis. Georik column 2 and the wiki Copper line agree for every mutation. copper.analyzeFirst = the extra one-time Copper first-time bonus stated on each wiki mutation page (additional to the repeat reward). Georik has no first-time column. copper.coinsCost = Georik column 3 = the wiki analyze price in coins (Cheesebite 80,000 for 80 Copper, 1k coins per Copper; every other mutation is 2k coins per Copper). copper.sheetBoosted60 = Georik column 3 (the sheet header says Total Boost 60%): repeat x 1.6 + 1 (Ashwreath 5 -> 9), i.e. the mass-analyze payout with the 60% boost plus the mass-analyze +1 bug, confirmed by video 47x Ashwreath = 376 Copper (8 each). Not a first-time bonus.

Spreading conditions are the wiki Mutations table counts. Each count is the number of the 8 neighbours (all adjacent including diagonals) of the empty slot that must be that crop. Spawn chance follows the Admin statement: weight x (fraction of the listed neighbour requirements satisfied); chancePercent is the wiki listed chance assuming all requirements are fully met (Ashwreath 15% because Fire is not a crop, confirmed 15%). Roll happens at each global greenhouse growth stage tick (base every 4 hours), per the video notes.

Condition crop ids: base crops and FIRE and FERMENTO (Fermento is a base crop id not in the requested set) use kind BASE; mutations use kind MUTATION including DEAD_PLANT. SPECIAL entries carry specialNote.

Drops are the fixed wiki amounts (min = max); actual amounts are scaled by yield multipliers. Drop item ids are friendly ids (MELON_SLICE for melon slices, COCOA_BEANS, NETHER_WART), not NEU raw ids. itemId is the wiki infobox id (matches the bazaar id) for each mutation; NEU repo was not checked.

tooltip: line 1 is the wiki description; the Crop Analyzer line and the RARITY MUTATION line are only verbatim-confirmed from the All-in Aloe item tooltip in video notes and are assumed identical for the others.

effects use the wiki Mutations table effect lines; Cheesebite (HARVEST_LOSS) and Chloronite (XP_BOOST) additionally come from the individual wiki pages because the table omits them. Timestalk Harvest Loss is shown green in the wiki table but is a -20% yield debuff on its page.
Wiki table notes mutationValue (minimum number of other mutations generated); INFINITE for Magic Jellybean. null = blank in wiki.
uncertain: Glasscorn growth stages: wiki page says 8 (harvest at 7-8, reset at 8) but the Mutations table shows 9; 8 used.
Startlevine harvest requirement: wiki says Invisibility potion effect; video notes say Sorrow Armor. Wiki used.

Spreading counts differ from the older video recipe cards (e.g. Dustgrain 4 Wheat in video vs 2 on the wiki, Ashwreath 4 Wart + 4 Fire vs 2/2, Snoozling gained Duskbloom 3). Wiki used (page history shows reductions).
Godseed: conditions are not a numeric count on the wiki (all positive effects present); 12 unique base crops is from the user/video notes. chance 5%.
chancePercent null for Shellfruit, Jerryflower, Dead Plant (no spread roll); weight null for them (admin weight 0 = special conditions).
Fermento is not in the requested BASE crop id set; used FERMENTO.
Jerryflower farming XP, tooltip first-line verified from wiki; Jerryflower drops none (wiki). Jerryflower copper first-time bonus 250 from its page.
Dead Plant: no Copper (not analyzable), no tooltip text on the wiki, surface null.

Per-mutation decay timers other than Dead Plant lowest 3 days and none for All-in Aloe, Fleshtrap, Magic Jellybean are not on the wiki (decay null = unknown); decay is read in-game with the Plant Diagnostics Tool.
Puffercloud 4% max HP spore damage and PlantBoy/Stoplight retry rules are marked unconfirmed on the wiki.
Mutation Value for Turtlellini, Stoplight Petal, All-in Aloe, Devourer, Glasscorn, Godseed, Jerryflower, Phantomleaf, Timestalk is blank on the wiki (null); Shellfruit 6.
Devourer farming XP: table says 30400 but its page says 3400 (probable page typo); table value used. Creambloom XP: table 4480, page 4480.
NEU repo item ids were not verified; itemId comes from the wiki infobox id.

mutations.name: Ashwreath

tooltip: It rises from ashen ground, gray and whispering.
Analyze this Mutation at the Crop Analyzer in Jake's Underground Lab.

Basic food +2 hunger; Enchanted +4 hunger and +20% bonus drop; Enchanted cooked +6 hunger and +40% bonus drop; bonus drop caps at +100% (can still give up to 3). Cannot grow when hunger is 0. Message when full: [CROP] Fleshtrap: I'm already full! Does not decay.
tooltip: A twisted version of the Venus Flytrap, this plant thrives on feeding its insatiable hunger for flesh. It requires regular offerings to stay alive, or it withers away.

mutations.name: Jerryflower
mutations.specialNote: Grown from a Fertilized Jerryseed planted on Farmland; at stage 5 it waits for Move Jerry. Not spread.

Hidden from the All Mutations menu until discovered; cannot go in Mutations Sacks. Acquisition chain (videos): Unfulfilled Jerryseed from a Jerry visitor, Mysterious Crop to Xalx (Crystal Hollows), reforge to Dirty, Dirt Guy (Dwarven Mines), plant, feed Move Jerrys until stage 10.
tooltip: Jerryflower never sleeps, Jerryflower never stops, Jerryflower is always watching.
Analyze this Mutation at the Crop Analyzer in Jake's Underground Lab.

mutations.name: Phantomleaf
mutations.behaviour: Does not need water. On harvest it hides in a random crop in the Greenhouse for 60 seconds with a heart icon and heartbeat; click the correct crop to harvest it, wrong crop or timeout destroys it. If there are no other crops it does nothing. Messages: Poof! Try and find me! / You have 45/30/15/5 seconds left! / Time's up! You didn't find me fast enough! / That's not me! Better luck next time! / You found me! / I have no where to hide!
tooltip: It hides in plain sight, blending in with its surroundings until it's ready to reveal itself. If you listen closely, you can hear its pulse guiding you to the right spot.
Analyze this Mutation at the Crop Analyzer in Jake's Underground Lab.
LEGENDARY MUTATION
mutations.unlock: Find the hidden Phantomleaf within 60 seconds

mutations.name: Dead Plant
mutations.specialNote: Not a spreading mutation. A crop that reaches -100 water becomes a Dead Plant; decay also turns most fully grown mutations (even watered or player-placed) into Dead Plants after a few days (lowest 3 days; some mutations never decay). Tradeable item, sells to NPC for 500, storable in Mutations Sacks. Used for Witherbloom and Zombud.
mutations.behaviour: Dead crops do not need water. Per the user, decay hits 5 days after the last watering, or 9 days total if the crop cannot be watered.
